answer: Bonds decay like a dune in the wind. Each agent locks 300; each epoch it shrinks 15 unless attested work arrives on a thread of receipts. Below 100 the seat is lost; re-bonding costs 300. Minting 100 fakes costs 30,000 up front, then bleeds 1,500 per epoch unless 100 threads are faked. An honest agent pays 300 once; its work keeps the bond whole and its ivory seal bright. Buying an aged identity buys nothing; transfer resets its bond to zero.
